name: Band Front Raise
cardText:
Band Front Raise
Novice
1
Stand on the band with one or 2 feet depending on how heavy you want the band to be.
2
With your elbows extended raise your fists straight up to the ceiling until they are at eye level.

name: Mini Band Bent Arm Lateral Raise
cardText:
Mini Band Bent Arm Lateral Raise
Novice
1
Loop band around elbows, arms bent 90 degrees at sides.
2
Raise both elbows outward to shoulder height.
3
Lower slowly and alternate, keeping tension on band.

name: Mini Band Alternating Bent Arm Lateral Raise
cardText:
Mini Band Alternating Bent Arm Lateral Raise
Novice
1
Loop band around elbows, arms bent 90 degrees at sides.
2
Raise one elbow outward to shoulder height.
3
Lower slowly and alternate, keeping tension on band.

name: Mini Band Clock Tap
cardText:
Mini Band Clock Tap
Novice
1
Loop band around ankles, stand tall on one leg.
2
Tap opposite foot forward, side, then back.
3
Maintain balance and hip stability throughout movement.

name: Band Upright Row
cardText:
Band Upright Row
Advanced
1
Stand with one or both feet on one end of a band. Take a double overhand roughly shoulder width grip.
2
Pull your elbows straight up the ceiling. Aim to get the band to chin level or slightly higher.

name: Band Single Arm Lateral Raise
cardText:
Band Single Arm Lateral Raise
Beginner
1
Stand on band and hold handle or loop at your side with slight elbow bend.
2
Raise arm out to the side until shoulder height, keeping torso still.
3
Lower slowly under control, maintaining constant tension on the delt.
